'''Resik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the period of time known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He served the Empire by selling armor on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
